roles.reason: Typed state, transaction, epoch, provenance and replay authority.
Projection and diagnostic topology must never mint truth or effect authority.
Can be rebuilt/reranked; correctness requires provenance/result receipts rather than storage merger.
Physical consolidation adds contention/amplification without semantic benefit.
State/effect mutation must present exact admitted execution generation; external floor prevents DB-snapshot rollback from reviving stale generations.
Same-source/same-epoch sibling state must not both be accepted as current.
If stored only in the same rollback domain as UnifiedDB it cannot detect whole-DB snapshot rewind.
Target evidence reports SQLite 3.45.1 + WAL; upstream WAL-reset corruption bug affects versions through 3.51.2 absent verified backport/topology exclusion.
A snapshot is admissible only when its lineage head and external generation remain current/recovery-valid.

physical_unification_law: Semantic/logical unification does not require one physical engine. KEEP_ISOLATED is promoted where rollback-domain independence or resource behavior requires it.
